A '''''Consular''-class cruiser''', commanded by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Zak/Legends|Zak]], was used to transport [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|negotiations]] on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
